description: This file defines the ExternalEventSourceService class, which provides a method to retrieve source packages from a collection of ExternalEventSourceProvider instances in the context of the Fineract project.

classes.name: ExternalEventSourceService
classes.description: A Spring component that aggregates external event source package information from registered providers.

methods.name: getSourcePackages
methods.description: Returns a list of package names provided by all registered ExternalEventSourceProvider instances.
